applicabilityBasis.summary: iUSD is a USD-referenced synthetic asset minted via collateralized debt positions or token-to-token PSM swaps. Current V3 redemption delivers ADA/CNT collateral subject to ratio criteria or paired stable-value tokens subject to liquidity and DAO controls. No verified legal issuer undertaking to redeem for fixed national-currency monetary value was found. General dollar-oriented use nevertheless leaves payment-stablecoin applicability genuinely unresolved.

genius.notes: Indigo Laboratories Inc is identified as developer in the 2022 disclaimer, not established as iUSD legal issuer. Current V3 docs identify initial Indigo Foundation control of the optional redeemer signer; this control is not itself a fiat-redemption obligation or GENIUS issuer authorization. No named public authorization or application/intent was found; this is not a finding of non-compliance or conclusive exemption.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The checked public disclosures, named searches and regulator materials did not locate an Indigo iUSD GENIUS approval, public official application, state qualification, foreign registration or issuer-announced route. NYDFS ordinary licensing is not GENIUS qualification; rulemaking materials are not token approvals. Absence is bounded to sources checked and cannot rule out an unpublished application.
